items.title: Not One Analyst Rates Broadcom a Sell. What Are They Missing?
items.summary: Wall Street analysts are unanimous on Broadcom, yet the loudest skeptics sit on CNBC, and the stock has dropped after beating earnings before. Financing risks, supply limits, and a split in institutional money complicate the bullish picture.

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Dropped, What Is Behind The Latest Attention?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) has been in the spotlight after agreeing to acquire optical networking specialist Lumentum in an all stock deal valued near US$115b, tying the chip designer more tightly to long term AI data center spending. The share price reaction has been choppy. Marvell Technology’s stock is down about 39% over the past month and 26% over 90 days, after a sharp reassessment of the Lumentum deal and sectorwide AI concerns. Even so, it still shows an 84% year to date share price...

items.title: Marvell Soars 23%, Lumentum Up 23% in a Week. Jim Cramer Says It’s Not “a Broken Stock”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMarvell Technology stock soared 23% in a week, and Lumentum, which Marvell agreed to buy, rose almost as much. CoreWeave’s beat-and-raise revived the AI trade, though Lumentum still trades below the deal’s value.

items.title: Lumentum Stocks Edge Higher as Marvell Deal Spread Widens to 19.7%
items.summary: Lumentum trades well below the value of the 4.5 Marvell shares it will receive, with closing not expected until 2028.

items.title: Marvell Stocks Edge Higher as NVIDIA Exit Weighs on Lumentum Deal Currency
items.summary: Marvell share price fluctuate with AI chip names, with the dollar value of its all-stock Lumentum offer ahead of December 1 earnings.

items.title: Marvell makes major board move ahead of $115 billion AI deal
items.summary: The chipmaker expands its board to 10 members as it prepares for a major deal in optical networking.

items.title: Microsoft Is Fighting a Ban on Chinese Parts Inside AI Data Centers
items.summary: Microsoft took its fight against a proposed FCC transceiver ban straight to the White House, yet the stock barely flinched while optical suppliers surged. The real story hinges on a speed threshold and a date years away.

items.title: AI’s Central Bank Is in Crisis. Intel and These Stocks Are Feeling the Pain.
items.summary: Intel stock falls along with Marvell, Lumentum, and Coherent after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigned. Here's why that is bad news.
